report:
Fresh refresh after consuming current full claim, implementation file, all eight test fragments, and association metadata. Delta assessment: invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review gained the record_required test association; whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits gained source_representation association. Their assertions remain intact. Recaptured check_reviews now includes review_diagnostics association and shifted line locations; its inventory/validate/acceptable execution is unchanged. These changes do not weaken freshness behavior or evidence. The independently reassessed claim-specific rationale follows.

Fresh review of meta.reviews.fragment_freshness after the added regressions and association fixes. Complete requirements: recording and checking validate every fragment against current selected source by exact equality; missing, ambiguous, invalid, and changed selections invalidate the review; neither origin nor selector kind bypasses this. The ordinary review.rs association covers inventory, select, input_errors, record, validate, and acceptable in the same captured file. Inventory regenerates initial claim/whole-file/test fragments and rejects duplicate test identities across all anchors. input_errors requires that complete ordered initial prefix to equal the fresh inventory (including contents), then resolves every appended fragment through select and compares text exactly with saved lines joined by newline. Selection errors are recorded as errors. select handles all four variants: whole-file exact reads, one-based inclusive ranges with zero/reversed/out-of-bounds rejection, claims with identity/path and inventory checks, and tests with exact crate/target/path identity requiring a unique span. record rejects input_errors before output publication. validate and acceptable use the same function; the captured check_reviews caller builds a fresh inventory and routes checking through these functions. Thus initial and appended context use equivalent freshness semantics without normalizing selected whitespace.

All eight ordinary associated tests were inspected completely. ambiguous_initial_test_selector_cannot_be_recorded_as_complete_context rejects duplicate function spans initially and asserts check failure; ambiguous_test_identity_across_anchors_is_rejected covers conflicting identities assigned different anchors. declared_claim_read_tracks_selected_text_without_capturing_the_document asserts exact claim capture, successful recording, acceptance after an unrelated heading, and check failure after changed claim text. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits asserts CRLF, blank-line and unterminated-final-line preservation, invalid range rejection, acceptance after an unselected edit, rejection after selected edits, repeated whole-file retention, and rejection for a changed trailing newline. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review now explicitly supplies stale recording coverage: implementation text changes, recording errors, saved input stays byte-identical, and checking fails; its report-format cases do not substitute for that assertion. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement explicitly appends a Test read, records successfully, accepts unchanged function movement, and rejects cfg metadata changes.

The two new tests close the remaining gaps. disappeared_or_invalidated_additional_fragments_reject_recording captures a real dependency, then independently deletes the whole file or truncates it so the saved range is out of bounds; record must fail with that dependency path, publish no output, and preserve exact input bytes. Its final check-failure assertion also confirms the active review remains failing (not an independent completed-review freshness baseline). another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity reads a different anchor's test, then changes only its body, renames it, or introduces conflicting cfg-selected identities. It asserts original anchor initial fragments and test metadata remain unchanged in the body and rename cases, so appended selection validation is essential; every case rejects record and publishes no output. Ambiguity can validly fail at global inventory validation. Together these tests exercise each selector and both origins, exact selected text, missing/invalid/ambiguous resolution, stale record rejection, and the shared checking path; they do not need every selector/error/command cross-product because the common input_errors path was directly inspected. No TODO/N/A entries exist or are needed. No unresolved production defect or coverage request remains.

Extra dependencies recaptured: tests/review.rs lines 1-105 (Fixture helpers) and check.rs lines 433-520 (complete current check_reviews). All relevant review implementation helpers remain included in the initial whole-file fragment. This refresh personally executed review start/read/record and source inspection only; no source edits, broad tests, build, or formatting command were run during this refresh. Coordinator reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests, and workspace build passed; these are separate reported execution, not commands run by this reviewer. No requested edits remain.
